_comment_ConnectionStrings: Mat khau de thang trong file nay chi chap nhan duoc vi day la VM lab, khong phai moi truong that.
Cach sach hon (khong commit mat khau):
_comment_Management: Rao an toan cho thao tac GHI (tao/sua/xoa task va service).
WritablePrefix: chi thao tac duoc doi tuong co ten bat dau bang tien to nay.
AllowedExecutableDirectories / AllowedExecutables: whitelist cho duong dan SE CHAY
(task Command, service BinaryPath). Khong co whitelist thi mot o text tren trinh
duyet tao duoc service chay LocalSystem tro toi file bat ky.
GIOI HAN: whitelist chan DUONG DAN, khong chan HANH VI - 'cmd.exe /c <lenh>' van chay.
Bo cmd.exe khoi danh sach neu muon chat hon. CO Y khong co powershell.exe vi no
nhan -EncodedCommand, dung thu ma RiskScorer cham la High.
_comment_EventLog: Channels: moi channel dung mot EventLogWatcher rieng.
- 'System'  : chua 7045/7040/7036/7034 (service) - KHONG can quyen admin de doc.
- 'Security': chua 4698-4702 (task) va 4697 - BAT BUOC chay app bang quyen Administrator,
va phai bat Audit Policy 'Other Object Access Events' thi 4698-4702 moi sinh ra.
4698-4702 - vi du 200/201 la task THUC SU CHAY, khong co o Security). Channel nay
MAC DINH TAT tren Windows, phai bat tay (quyen Administrator):
Chua bat thi channel nay subscribe loi (log ra, khong crash app).
- Khi da cau hinh Windows Event Forwarding thi doi thanh [ 'ForwardedEvents' ].
ReadExistingEvents: de true neu muon doc luon event cu trong log de lay mau XML nhanh.
